faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Non-Engineering Interns posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Non-Engineering Interns positions at Life Mission Kerala is 30th September 2026. Ensure you complete and submit your application before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Non-Engineering Interns role?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Non-Engineering Interns position, candidates must be any graduate with proficiency in computer skills. This ensures candidates have the basic technical understanding needed for the role.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Non-Engineering Interns?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Non-Engineering Interns positions in the Life Mission Kerala recruitment drive for 2026. This offers a limited but valuable opportunity.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Non-Engineering Interns position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Non-Engineering Interns role will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 10,000. This provides a modest financial benefit during the internship period.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the Life Mission Kerala Non-Engineering Interns recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for both General/OBC and SC/ST categories is Rs. 500/-. This fee is required to process your application for the Non-Engineering Interns positions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these intern positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Non-Engineering Interns positions involves a Screening Process, followed by a Written Test, and finally an Interview. Candidates must clear each stage to be considered.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the Non-Engineering Interns positions are contractual. This means the employment is for a fixed tenure, not a permanent government position.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Kerala apply?
faq.answer: The notification specifically mentions inviting applications from eligible candidates in Kerala. It is advisable to check the official notification for any specific domicile requirements.

faq.answer: The provided data does not specify an age limit for the Non-Engineering Interns positions. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any age-related criteria.
